purpose: Authentication identities and role-based access control.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the user (Firebase UID).

role.description: Role of the user in the system.

photoURL.description: Profile picture URL of the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user was last updated.

access_patterns.parent: read/write own profile, read child profiles

validation_rules: role must be one of the predefined roles.
email must be a valid email address.
performance_notes: Ensure indexes on role for admin queries.
